**A quick explainer on wheel truing:**
When a wheel is "out of true," it means it wobbles side-to-side (or is out of round) as it spins — often caused by impacts, potholes, or normal wear. Truing involves a mechanic adjusting the tension of the spokes with a spoke wrench while the wheel spins against a truing stand, gently pulling the rim back into alignment. It ensures smooth, straight rolling, better braking, and prevents further damage to the wheel. It's a fairly quick service when there are no serious bends or broken spokes — if we find anything more severe during the check, we'll let you know before doing any additional work.
